adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the sync path is gated by `... && userId` (userId must be truthy). If `userId` is `null` (as the finding assumes for team-owned credentials), the function will always take the `else` branch and refresh locally, with no log or explicit indication that credential syncing was skipped. The diff shows this behavior clearly; whether team credentials *should* be synced is a product/design expectation not provable from the diff, so this is best treated as an edge-case/incompleteness concern rather than a definite defect.
